s0401.literal: On jiashen day Prince of Weishun Kanchi Buqa was ordered back to his garrison at Huguang.
s0401.idiomatic: On jiashen day Prince of Weishun Kanchi Buqa was ordered back to his garrison at Huguang.

s0402.literal: Associate censor-in-chief Zhao Shiyan requested resignation on account of old age and illness; this was not granted; following the precedent of former associate censor-in-chief Cui Yu, he was additionally made grand councillor while retaining his prior post.
s0402.idiomatic: Associate censor-in-chief Zhao Shiyan requested resignation on account of old age and illness; this was not granted; following the precedent of former associate censor-in-chief Cui Yu, he was additionally made grand councillor while retaining his prior post.

s0403.literal: Censorate officials said: "The mobile Bureau of Buddhist Affairs and mobile Directorate of Waterways should be abolished.
s0403.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "The mobile Bureau of Buddhist Affairs and mobile Directorate of Waterways should be abolished.

s0405.literal: On bingxu day a water-and-land Buddhist assembly was performed.
s0405.idiomatic: On bingxu day a water-and-land Buddhist assembly was performed.

s0406.literal: Aruqai Temür and five others, who at Shangdu had wished to raise righteous action but failed and died, were all posthumously granted titles and posthumous names, and their families were granted relief.
s0406.idiomatic: Aruqai Temür and 5 others, who at Shangdu had wished to raise righteous action but failed and died, were all posthumously granted titles and posthumous names, and their families were granted relief.

s0407.literal: Yan Timur said: "The darughachis of prefectures and counties under the jurisdictions of the Prince of Jin and Prince of Lia and others having already been dismissed, the Imperial Clan Court jarquchi and central secretariat adjudication officials they recommended, being all their private men, should likewise be removed.
s0407.idiomatic: Yan Timur said: "The darughachis of prefectures and counties under the jurisdictions of the Prince of Jin and Prince of Lia and others having already been dismissed, the Imperial Clan Court jarquchi and central secretariat adjudication officials they recommended, being all their private men, should likewise be removed.

s0409.literal: Zhao Shiyan and Hanlin academicians-direct Yu Ji were ordered to compose the censorate stele inscription.
s0409.idiomatic: Zhao Shiyan and Hanlin academicians-direct Yu Ji were ordered to compose the censorate stele inscription.

s0410.literal: Troops of the various guards were each dispatched back to their garrisons.
s0410.idiomatic: Troops of the various guards were each dispatched back to their garrisons.

s0412.literal: The relevant offices were ordered to investigate and recover advance-salary payments by Shangdu officials.
s0412.idiomatic: The relevant offices were ordered to investigate and recover advance-salary payments by Shangdu officials.

s0413.literal: Badu, son of Prince of Lia Toghto, gathered a band and went out plundering; Xuande Prefecture officials were ordered to capture him.
s0413.idiomatic: Badu, son of Prince of Lia Toghto, gathered a band and went out plundering; Xuande Prefecture officials were ordered to capture him.

s0414.literal: Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor Nangjiatai styled himself Prince Who Pacifies the West; he made his branch left vice chancellor Tuotuo grand councillor, former Yunnan surveillance commissioner Yang Jing left vice chancellor, killed branch grand councillors including Kanchi and other officials, raised troops, and burned and cut off plank roads.
s0414.idiomatic: Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor Nangjiatai styled himself Prince Who Pacifies the West; he made his branch left vice chancellor Tuotuo grand councillor, former Yunnan surveillance commissioner Yang Jing left vice chancellor, killed branch grand councillors including Kanchi and other officials, raised troops, and burned and cut off plank roads.

s0415.literal: Wumeng Route professor Du Yanxiao said: "Under the sage illumination of succession to the throne, the realm within the Four Seas is greatly tranquil; provincial officials should cease arms and enter court, so that harm to one region may be avoided.
s0415.idiomatic: Wumeng Route professor Du Yanxiao said: "Under the sage illumination of succession to the throne, the realm within the Four Seas is greatly tranquil; provincial officials should cease arms and enter court, so that harm to one region may be avoided.

s0416.literal: " Nangjiatai, because of his reckless words misleading the multitude, flogged him with one hundred seven blows of the staff and imprisoned him.
s0416.idiomatic: Nangjiatai, because of his reckless words misleading the multitude, flogged him with 107 blows of the staff and imprisoned him.

s0417.literal: Twelfth month, on jichou new moon, an investigating censor said Bayan should be rewarded for merit on the same terms as Yan Timur; the Emperor said: "Bayan's merit — my heart knows it; the censor need not speak of it.
s0417.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on jichou new moon, an investigating censor said Bayan should be rewarded for merit on the same terms as Yan Timur; the Emperor said: "Bayan's merit — my heart knows it; the censor need not speak of it.

s0418.literal: " On gengyin day orders were issued to all offices within and without that for the Heavenly Longevity Festival meat dishes may be prepared, while among the populace slaughter was forbidden as in the former system.
s0418.idiomatic: " On gengyin day orders were issued to all offices within and without that for the Heavenly Longevity Festival meat dishes may be prepared, while among the populace slaughter was forbidden as in the former system.

s0419.literal: The Bureau of Transmission was ordered to rectify the Mongol relay stations.
s0419.idiomatic: The Bureau of Transmission was ordered to rectify the Mongol relay stations.

s0420.literal: At various passes where commoners' houses had once been demolished for obstruction, notes were granted to the people so they might restore them.
s0420.idiomatic: At various passes where commoners' houses had once been demolished for obstruction, notes were granted to the people so they might restore them.

s0421.literal: On jiawu day Wang Chan's male and female slaves were granted to Prince of Zhennan Tiemur Buqa and Yan Timur.
s0421.idiomatic: On jiawu day Wang Chan's male and female slaves were granted to Prince of Zhennan Tiemur Buqa and Yan Timur.

s0422.literal: On yiwei day Wang Chan's bows and arrows were granted to Yan Timur and Bayan.
s0422.idiomatic: On yiwei day Wang Chan's bows and arrows were granted to Yan Timur and Bayan.

s0423.literal: Yan Timur requested that the fields and residences of Mashsha and eight others be granted to Yan Bulin and eight others; it was approved.
s0423.idiomatic: Yan Timur requested that the fields and residences of Mashsha and 8 others be granted to Yan Bulin and 8 others; it was approved.

s0424.literal: On bingwu day the Emperor visited the Great Monastery of Great Blessing, Fortune, and Primordial Origin and paid respects at Wuzong's spirit hall.
s0424.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor visited the Great Monastery of Great Blessing, Fortune, and Primordial Origin and paid respects at Wuzong's spirit hall.

s0425.literal: Orders were separately issued to various monks to perform Buddhist rites at the Great Bright Hall, Extended Spring Pavilion, Xingsheng Palace, Longfu Palace, and Longevity Mountain.
s0425.idiomatic: Orders were separately issued to various monks to perform Buddhist rites at the Great Bright Hall, Extended Spring Pavilion, Xingsheng Palace, Longfu Palace, and Longevity Mountain.

s0426.literal: Yunnan native officials including Pushuang came to present local products.
s0426.idiomatic: Yunnan native officials including Pushuang came to present local products.

s0427.literal: Censorate officials said: "Yesunie, wherever he led troops, killed officials on his own authority and captured and plundered children, women, and goods and wealth.
s0427.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "Yesunie, wherever he led troops, killed officials on his own authority and captured and plundered children, women, and goods and wealth.

s0428.literal: " An edict ordered the Ministry of Justice to try him, confiscate his household property, flog him with one hundred seven blows of the staff, and banish him to Nanning; his wife was ordered to return to her parents' house.
s0428.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Ministry of Justice to try him, confiscate his household property, flog him with 107 blows of the staff, and banish him to Nanning; his wife was ordered to return to her parents' house.

s0429.literal: On jihai day the empress's jade book and jade seal were made.
s0429.idiomatic: On jihai day the empress's jade book and jade seal were made.

s0430.literal: On gengzi day an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
s0430.idiomatic: On gengzi day an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

s0431.literal: Prince Mantu was enfeoffed as Prince of Guo; Amalatai was enfeoffed as Prince of Yi; Imperial Clan Court jarquchi Kuokuochu and sixteen others were all granted meritorious subject titles and ranks, official grades, titles, and posthumous names; the relevant offices were still ordered to inscribe their merit on steles, and notes were granted to relieve their families.
s0431.idiomatic: Prince Mantu was enfeoffed as Prince of Guo; Amalatai was enfeoffed as Prince of Yi; Imperial Clan Court jarquchi Kuokuochu and 16 others were all granted meritorious subject titles and ranks, official grades, titles, and posthumous names; the relevant offices were still ordered to inscribe their merit on steles, and notes were granted to relieve their families.

s0432.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Shaanxi branch secretariat and branch censorate officials burned and discarded an imperial edict; by law the crime warrants exile; although they were pardoned by amnesty, it is fitting that they never be employed again.
s0432.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Shaanxi branch secretariat and branch censorate officials burned and discarded an imperial edict; by law the crime warrants exile; although they were pardoned by amnesty, it is fitting that they never be employed again.

s0434.literal: On xinchou day the Dragon Wing Guard Personal Army Metropolitan Commander-in-Chief's Office was established, in charge of Kipchak troops, rank upper third grade;
s0434.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Dragon Wing Guard Personal Army Metropolitan Commander-in-Chief's Office was established, in charge of Kipchak troops, rank upper third grade;

s0435.literal: Three commanders were appointed; Yan Timur and Bolanxi and Muohan were made them; the remaining officials were all left to Yan Timur to select men and report.
s0435.idiomatic: 3 commanders were appointed; Yan Timur and Bolanxi and Muohan were made them; the remaining officials were all left to Yan Timur to select men and report.

s0436.literal: Gaochang monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Hall of Precious Kindness.
s0436.idiomatic: Gaochang monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Hall of Precious Kindness.

s0437.literal: Jiangnan branch censor said: "Prince of Lia Toghto, from his grandfather's time onward, has repeatedly rebelled; this is because his enfeoffment is broad and his resources abundant — the princely title should be stripped, his descendants placed in distant regions, and his original fief lands divided up.
s0437.idiomatic: Jiangnan branch censor said: "Prince of Lia Toghto, from his grandfather's time onward, has repeatedly rebelled; this is because his enfeoffment is broad and his resources abundant — the princely title should be stripped, his descendants placed in distant regions, and his original fief lands divided up.

s0438.literal: " An edict directed the central secretariat to deliberate the matter with meritorious old ministers.
s0438.idiomatic: An edict directed the central secretariat to deliberate the matter with meritorious old ministers.

s0439.literal: Huo'erhuda and thirteen others followed Prince of Xiangning Balashiri in military service; after they were executed, orders were issued to confiscate all their household property.
s0439.idiomatic: Huo'erhuda and 13 others followed Prince of Xiangning Balashiri in military service; after they were executed, orders were issued to confiscate all their household property.

s0440.literal: One hundred Western monks performed Buddhist rites at Huiyou Pavilion for seven days.
s0440.idiomatic: 100 Western monks performed Buddhist rites at Huiyou Pavilion for 7 days.

s0441.literal: On guimao day the Kipchak and Asud two divisions were granted fodder and grain on the same terms as palace guard soldiers.
s0441.idiomatic: On guimao day the Kipchak and Asud 2 divisions were granted fodder and grain on the same terms as palace guard soldiers.

s0442.literal: On yisi day Bayan was made grand marshal and commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies; he and Yeliechi were both made censor-in-chief, jointly to strengthen censorate authority; an edict was issued throughout the realm.
s0442.idiomatic: On yisi day Bayan was made grand marshal and commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies; he and Yeliechi were both made censor-in-chief, jointly to strengthen censorate authority; an edict was issued throughout the realm.

s0443.literal: The Inner Steward Directorate was established, subordinate to the Superintendent of Stored Blessings, rank upper third grade.
s0443.idiomatic: The Inner Steward Directorate was established, subordinate to the Superintendent of Stored Blessings, rank upper third grade.

s0444.literal: The fields and residences of Abe and five others were granted to princes including Lao and five others.
s0444.idiomatic: The fields and residences of Abe and 5 others were granted to princes including Lao and 5 others.

s0445.literal: Gao Ming, magistrate of Yao Prefecture in Yunnan, came to present local products.
s0445.idiomatic: Gao Ming, magistrate of Yao Prefecture in Yunnan, came to present local products.

s0446.literal: On wushen day one hundred fifty craftsmen used by the latent residence were entrusted to Prince Alaqtenadara; a Special Works Bureau was established to administer them, rank lower fourth grade.
s0446.idiomatic: On wushen day 150 craftsmen used by the latent residence were entrusted to Prince Alaqtenadara; a Special Works Bureau was established to administer them, rank lower fourth grade.

s0447.literal: Bayan was further made grand preceptor; privy council director Buqa Temür was made grand marshal; Xiangshan was made minister of works.
s0447.idiomatic: Bayan was further made grand preceptor; privy council director Buqa Temür was made grand marshal; Xiangshan was made minister of works.

s0448.literal: On jiyou day the wine prohibition at Shangdu was lifted.
s0448.idiomatic: On jiyou day the wine prohibition at Shangdu was lifted.

s0449.literal: On renzi day the civilian artisan chief offices of the various routes were combined into a directorship, rank lower fifth grade.
s0449.idiomatic: On renzi day the civilian artisan chief offices of the various routes were combined into a directorship, rank lower fifth grade.

s0450.literal: On jiayin day investigating supervising censor Sadi and inner attendant Buyan Tugusi were again dispatched to escort the imperial elder brother from the northern desert.
s0450.idiomatic: On jiayin day investigating supervising censor Sadi and inner attendant Buyan Tugusi were again dispatched to escort the imperial elder brother from the northern desert.

s0451.literal: Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri and Yan Timur and Tiemur Buqhua each requested to dispatch men to send noted hawks to the imperial whereabouts.
s0451.idiomatic: Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri and Yan Timur and Tiemur Buqhua each requested to dispatch men to send noted hawks to the imperial whereabouts.

s0452.literal: Wang Chan's wife's gold, pearls, and head ornaments were returned to the empress's palace.
s0452.idiomatic: Wang Chan's wife's gold, pearls, and head ornaments were returned to the empress's palace.

s0453.literal: On bingchen day the Grand Blessings Court was raised to lower first grade; central secretariat left vice chancellor Yuegu Buhua was made superintendent of grand blessings.
s0453.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Grand Blessings Court was raised to lower first grade; central secretariat left vice chancellor Yuegu Buhua was made superintendent of grand blessings.

s0454.literal: On dingsi day Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri was enfeoffed as Prince of Yu and granted Nankang Route as fief.
s0454.idiomatic: On dingsi day Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri was enfeoffed as Prince of Yu and granted Nankang Route as fief.

s0455.literal: Chel Temür was promoted to right vice chancellor; associate administrator Yueli Temür was made left vice chancellor; secretariat deliberator Zhao Shi'an was made associate administrator.
s0455.idiomatic: Chel Temür was promoted to right vice chancellor; associate administrator Yueli Temür was made left vice chancellor; secretariat deliberator Zhao Shi'an was made associate administrator.

s0456.literal: On wuwu day an edict said: "In commanderies and counties afflicted by warfare, miscellaneous corvée is remitted, wine-brewing is forbidden, and prohibitions on mountain pastures and river marshes are relaxed;
s0456.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict said: "In commanderies and counties afflicted by warfare, miscellaneous corvée is remitted, wine-brewing is forbidden, and prohibitions on mountain pastures and river marshes are relaxed;

s0457.literal: Private mutual loans — repayment is to be demanded after the autumn harvest.
s0457.idiomatic: Private mutual loans — repayment is to be demanded after the autumn harvest.

s0458.literal: Mongols and Semu who wish to observe mourning for parents may do so according to the former system.
s0458.idiomatic: Mongols and Semu who wish to observe mourning for parents may do so according to the former system.

s0459.literal: " Censorate officials said: "Nangjiatai, resisting orders in the southwest, his crime cannot be pardoned; the commission edicts he was granted should be revoked.
s0459.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "Nangjiatai, resisting orders in the southwest, his crime cannot be pardoned; the commission edicts he was granted should be revoked.

s0460.literal: " Central secretariat officials said: "An edict has just permitted Nangjiatai and others to reform themselves — the censorate's proposal should not be carried out.
s0460.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "An edict has just permitted Nangjiatai and others to reform themselves — the censorate's proposal should not be carried out.

s0462.literal: Directorate of Music darughachi Sali'er, during Wuzong's time remotely invested as associate administrator, rank Middle Submissive Grand Master — an edict removed the remotely invested post while retaining his former rank.
s0462.idiomatic: Directorate of Music darughachi Sali'er, during Wuzong's time remotely invested as associate administrator, rank Middle Submissive Grand Master — an edict removed the remotely invested post while retaining his former rank.

s0463.literal: That month, envoys were again dispatched to summon Yunnan branch secretariat left chancellor Ye'erjini, but again he did not come.
s0463.idiomatic: That month, envoys were again dispatched to summon Yunnan branch secretariat left chancellor Ye'erjini, but again he did not come.

s0464.literal: Posthumous honors were added for Tang Minister of Works Yan Zhenqing as Duke Wenzhong of Zhenglie; the relevant offices were ordered to perform seasonal sacrifices.
s0464.idiomatic: Posthumous honors were added for Tang Minister of Works Yan Zhenqing as Duke Wenzhong of Zhenglie; the relevant offices were ordered to perform seasonal sacrifices.

s0465.literal: Shaanxi from the second year of Taiding until this year had no rain; great famine ensued, and the people ate one another.
s0465.idiomatic: Shaanxi from the second year of Taiding until this year had no rain; great famine ensued, and the people ate one another.

s0466.literal: Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Pingjiang, Huzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiande, Chizhou, Taiping, Guangde, and other routes suffered flooding; more than fourteen thousand qing of commoners' fields were inundated.
s0466.idiomatic: Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Pingjiang, Huzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiande, Chizhou, Taiping, Guangde, and other routes suffered flooding; more than 14,000 qing of commoners' fields were inundated.

s0467.literal: Hebei and Shandong had good harvests.
s0467.idiomatic: Hebei and Shandong had good harvests.
